gaingels-archer:greenhouse:4213164002.description: We're making an investment in the next generation of veterinary doctors! Our program is dedicated to contributing to your practice-readiness and to help you hit the ground running after graduation. Our program structure: Our externships are flexible—they can range from two to eight weeks during the year, according to your college curriculum – but are typically two or three weeks in length. Your schedule will include days, evenings and weekends. Our externship rotations are designed to allow students, under veterinary supervision, to practice the problem-solving, technical and communication skills that they have acquired during their clinical preparation. Who we're looking for: Extern students are expected to be enthusiastic and effective participants in our patient care activities, upholding the professional and ethical standards of our practice. Students participating in the externship program are suggested to review the Veterinary Practice Act in regard to the scope of duties that may be performed, and to be familiar with the type and degree of veterinary supervision that is required. Requirements: Be enrolled in an accredited DVM program. You are authorized to work in the United States. You must carry professional liability insurance. About us: As sponsors of the Veterinary Externship Program, we see ourselves to be part of your educational team, providing instruction, mentoring and evaluation of the students who participate. verdane-centra:teamtailor:8cba145b-bb52-.description: We're not just building an ecommerce platform. We’re reshaping how fashion & lifestyle brands scale globally. Our API-first, headless SaaS platform supports over 300 brands in delivering localized, high-performance shopping experiences across 120+ countries. Brands trust Centra to run operations in 20+ markets - a reflection of the platform’s flexibility and efficiency. Why Join Centra? You will build and own the data backbone of our new Data & Insights module. New team, greenfield development, everything to play for. You’ll take raw transactional data from our clients and transform it into high-performance “gold tables” that power real-time and analytical dashboards, making key architectural decisions along the way to ensure scalability, reliability, and speed. What You’ll Do. Build data pipelines. Design and orchestrate near real-time data ingestion from client databases (CDC, AWS DMS, GCP Datastream, Azure Data Factory/Fabric, etc.) Standardise metrics. Define and implement a single source of truth for key fashion KPIs using SQL and transformation tools (dbt, Dataform, etc.) Own performance and scalability so that everything goes faster. Architect caching and performance layers to support fast, reliable dashboards across 300+ clients, making pragmatic trade-offs between cost, latency and complexity. Develop APIs. Design and maintain serverless APIs (e.g. Lambda, Cloud Run) that power the frontend experience. Expand data sources. Evaluate, ingest, and integrate new third-party data sources alongside existing datasets. What We’re Looking For. Experience building and owning data platforms or products from scratch, including making architectural decisions. Expert-level SQL and strong experience modelling complex business domains. Proven ability to design scalable data systems in a cloud-native environment (AWS, GCP, or similar.) Comfortable making independent technical decisions within a product context, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability. Strong product thinking/product engineering mindset. You don’t just build tables, you understand how data drives decisions for customers and why a brand needs this data. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CDK.) MLOps experience is a plus You might be a senior data or analytics engineer who enjoys owning problems end-to-end, or a tech lead who prefers to stay hands-on while shaping architecture and product direction. Either way, you're excited about a role building a new module within an established company tackling complex problems in the e-commerce space. Our Recruitment Process. ( Online or onsite 1.5–2h ) Ways of Working Interview : Explore your alignment with our values and meet the team. ( Online or onsite, 1h ) Location and Logistics. This team is Wroclaw or Stockholm based. We operate an office-first, hybrid working model. You can work up to ten days per month remote. Equality. We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and to building a team with diverse perspectives. If you need adjustments during the process, please let us know.
